tools.name: fde_catalogue
tools.description: FREE. List every Forward Deployed Engineering rule, playbook, and checklist phase available from this server — id, title, phase, and tags, with the paid body withheld. Call this first to see what is on offer before paying for anything.

tools.name: fde_lessons_preview
tools.description: FREE. Return the foundational Forward Deployed Engineering rules in full, no payment required. Each rule carries the real incident behind it and an implementable agent-behavior constraint.

tools.name: fde_lessons_full
tools.description: PAID. Return the full Forward Deployed Engineering ruleset, or the subset matching a topic. Requires a machine payment (MPP over Stripe). If unpaid, returns the exact payment challenge and the URL to retry against.

tools.name: fde_playbook
tools.description: PAID. Return situational runbooks with ordered, checkable steps — DNS migration and static-site change. Use before executing that class of operation, not after it fails.

tools.name: fde_preship_checklist
tools.description: PAID. Return the pre-ship checklist: every gate to clear before shipping, each with the concrete failure it prevents. Designed to be called before every deploy.

tools.name: pricing_changes
tools.description: PAID. Return only the dated Agent Pricing Index corrections at or after a given date — what changed, not the full 47-row dataset. Backed by a monthly re-read against each vendor's own page. Cheaper than fde equivalent full-dataset calls when you only need to know what moved.

tools.name: pricing_benchmark
tools.description: FREE. What AI products and agents in one category actually charge: published-price counts, contact-sales share and median entry price from the Agent Pricing Index (every row read off the vendor's own page with a verbatim quote and read date), plus the private-submission benchmark where it has five o

tools.name: pricing_submit
tools.description: FREE, give-to-get. Add one AI product's price (list or a real quote) to the Agent Pricing Index private benchmark. Returns the category benchmark it unlocks. Individual submissions are never published; medians only at five or more per category.

tools.name: pricing_quote_check
tools.description: FREE, give-to-get. Check a price you were quoted (or plan to quote) for an AI product against the vendor's own published list price and the category. Returns discount off list, position in the category and data freshness. The quote is added to the private benchmark (never published individually), wh

tools.name: pricing_rows
tools.description: FREE. Return the published Agent Pricing Index rows for one category or product, each with the vendor's pricing URL, verbatim evidence quote and read date. Full dataset is CC BY 4.0, attribute to ignatiustheyoungerai.com/pricing-index.

tools.name: order_teardown
tools.description: Order a human-reviewed pricing teardown of one AI product from IgnatiusTheYoungerAI (enterprise-scale pricing operator). Returns the tiers and checkout links for the agent's operator. Use when a quote or price page needs a verdict, not a lookup.

tools.name: judgment_multiple
tools.description: FREE. The Judgment Multiple: annualized exposure divided by the annualized cost of the human control that guards it. Tells you whether a human reviewer on an AI workflow is cheap insurance or overhead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pricing_rows · Private data: pricing_benchmark, pricing_submit, pricing_quote_check · Public sink: fde_catalogue, fde_lessons_preview, fde_lessons_full, pricing_benchmark, pricing_submit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pricing_rows · Private data: pricing_benchmark, pricing_submit, pricing_quote_check · Public sink: fde_catalogue, fde_lessons_preview, fde_lessons_full, pricing_benchmark, pricing_submit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
